programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless

programme.title: Backroads Europe

Here, cultural traditions still burn bright.

programme.title: Backroads Europe
programme.desc: Italy's Via Cassia once led north from Rome to Florence, finally joining the Via Aurelia at Luna (now Luni). As you meander northward along the ancient route, each unique location you visit, and the interesting people you meet there, speak vividly to the region's steeped history and culture.

programme.title: Mythical Roads

programme.desc: When it comes to DIY'ing a shower it's important that your base is waterproof, square, and strong. In this tutorial I'll show every step I did to get a space in my bathroom ready for tile. If you have questions please leave them below and I'll do my best to answer them, if you see any you can answer, please leave any helpful tips! This is made to be a helpful video for any beginner wanting to install their first shower bed / base. Thanks a bunch for watching!!

programme.desc: More Australian design innovations. programme.desc: Can You Believe This Headboard is ALL plywood??? Time to get building! This bed was inspired by the horizontal slat design I incorporated in my recent TV console Build! Instead of cutting a bunch of strips and glueing up a slatted blank, I attached strips onto a 3/4" plywood backer board and it was definitely the way to go. Material isn't cheap right now and this is a great way of utilizing edge banding and plywood for a premium look! Thanks for watching!

programme.desc: Originally designed by Peter McIntyre, this Modernist courtyard house lacked a connection to the backyard. After years of living in the home, Albert Mo Architects looked to bridge the gap between the interior and the garden, enhancing the relationship they have with the landscape. Connected House builds on Peter McIntyre’s Modernist principles to create a home that balances the old and new, where the home and its landscape are seamlessly intertwined.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign - Innovations
programme.desc: Our group of design industry experts have found some of the best and innovative design innovations from around Australia. In this episode, No Thru – the smartest fence ever, also from Melbourne a new technology for testing potential cures for neurological diseases using ‘mini brains’, Blade Stop – saving accidental cuts and amputations in the meat cutting industry, TM Checker – a new app from IP Australia for checking trademarks, and Paragon – an innovation that uses golden balls to intensify the taste of coffee.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign - Innovations
programme.desc: Our team of design industry leaders continue their search for some of Australia’s most amazing design innovations. From Queensland, a new composting toilet system called Ecoflo, OZtent, the tent that can be erected in under 30 seconds, and CellAED, a home based heart starter device for saving lives. Also, from Brisbane comes Airgarden – new aeroponic technology for growing plants and from Western Sydney, Eyes of AI – an innovation to revolutionize dentistry.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign - Innovations
programme.desc: In this episode, from Melbourne, Quad Lock is a super smart way of housing your smart phone while you’re on the move, Cubbi Buddi – an innovation empowering kids play at home, and from regional NSW – the Wave is a high design grate developed by Stormtech. Also, the TPS Ranger for measuring water quality and from Sydney – Post Harvest is a super tech way of detecting fruit and vegetable freshness in the warehouse.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign - Innovations
programme.desc: Travelling far and wide across Australia, we uncover some of the countries brightest design innovations. In this episode, we look at an innovation that makes the sport of Bouldering more accessible, from Brisbane, a more cleanable design system for the humble chair, also from Brisbane – the Kurloo, for predicting catastrophic failure, and from Melbourne, the Kerfton, a new level in camper trailer design.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign - Innovations
programme.desc: Our team of design industry leaders are shining the light on some of Australia’s most impressive design innovations. From Sydney, Stic – a simple but clever walking stick attachment, a next level comfort face mask for the virtual gaming world, a new drain technology called Lauxes Grates, and from Beacon Design Studio, a fan, light and air purification unit all in one.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign - Innovations
programme.desc: Our ByDesign team of design industry leaders continue looking at more innovative design ideas from around Australia. In this episode, TermiSensor from Brisbane, a new technology for detecting termites, the Rodecaster video switcher, sensitive and inclusive design from Aliro Collection by ABI in the bathroom, and a smarter and more efficient way to grow green walls and roofs from Greenwall Eco Planters and Pillows.

programme.title: Hotels ByDesign
programme.desc: In episode 1 we begin with peak New York accommodation in the heart of Times Square itself. The Tempo, by Hilton, is a hotel that seeks to reflect the energy of time square and an ethos of exploration and discovery. Next Sara takes us to Ontario for our story on Elora Mill, one-of-a-kind bespoke accommodation, perched atop the thundering Elora Gorge amid stunning panoramic views. Then join us at the enchanting Ashford Castle - where Ireland’s history meets opulence, world-class service and unique experiences. We fly back to Chicago for some warm and stylish midwestern hospitality with our story on the Royal Sonesta Chicago Downtown. And finally, we’re off to Croatia for a lesson in “mindful luxury”. Executive Producer Mike Chapman investigates the alchemy between the personal and professional, a stunning location, sincere respect for the environment and chic contemporary design that makes Maslina Resort so special.

programme.title: Hotels ByDesign
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hotels ByDesign opens with the ultimate oceanfront urban escape at Prince Waikiki. Located at the gateway to urban Honolulu, discover the ingredients that have made this hotel a raging success! Then, get reacquainted with the natural cycles of nature and simpler times as Adam Rolston leads a story on Southall Farm & Inn in the rolling hills of Franklin Tennessee. Travel to India to explore the unique details of The Leela Palace: New Delhi, a true muse of the city's multifaceted legacy. Next, Executive Producer Mike Chapman discovers a collection of Chalets, with breathtaking views of Mt Blanc - L’Alpaga Resort in Megeve. The episode is capped by a story, presented by Scott Henderson about Wentworth Mansion in Charleston - where passion for restoring and revitalizing historical spaces is on full display.

programme.title: Austin Flipsters
programme.desc: The Austin Flipsters are tackling not one, not two, but THREE homes in the same neighborhood! 🏡 First up? The Pickle House! This unique property will get a jaw-dropping $100,000 renovation makeover for our Homemade client, Walter. From bold design choices to strategic upgrades, we're pulling out all the stops to transform this house into a dream home. Stay tuned for epic before-and-after reveals, renovation tips, and plenty of surprises along the way! 🔨

programme.title: America ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc:
Prepare to be wowed by The Liljestrand House, the only intact example of renowned architect Vladimir Ossipoff’s residential work open to the public.
Next up is 350 California Street, a collaborative effort to create a building that through its design and architecture facilitates innovation, creative co-working and sustainable climate conscious innovation.
Finally, we tour the Garde Gallery in New York City and discover how the “non-decorated” look can be both simple and precious, serious and whimsical.
The voting for the Ferguson People’s Choice Award for this season is now open! You can scan the QR code in the episode or head to bydesign.global to vote for your favourite story and you and a friend could win flights to New York, staying 2 nights at one of Sonesta’s 4 New York properties, enjoy an exclusive VIP guest tour of the Ferguson New York City showroom and select a range of lighting and fans for your project, courtesy of Minka Group.

programme.title: America ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Episode 4 of America ByDesign: Architecture opens with a showcase of 96+Broadway - a luxury Upper West Side condominium, designed by NYC-based Danish designer Thomas Juul-Hansen. Then we discover an adaptive reuse project that has become a cultural and entrepreneurial hub: The Beehive by SoLa Impact in Los Angeles. Next, it’s time to delve into how The School of the Art Institute of Chicago has reconceived the library as a central hub and point of connection through the thoughtful use of structure, space and light. Finally, join us at the opulent Ferguson New York City Showroom, designed to take clients through an architectural journey reflective of the history and style of the city!

programme.title: America ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Episode 5 opens with Executive Producer Mike Chapman on the rugged South Coast of Oregon at the Port Orford Seafood Hub. This is a story that explores an ambitious redevelopment designed to promote job growth and community awareness. Next, Thomas Wong presents a story on The Greenwich - one of the tallest residential buildings in New York and an architectural collaboration between the design powerhouses Rafael Viñoly Studio and March and White Design. Then, we showcase Twisted Ridge Mountain Retreat. This example of poetic architecture sits atop the hills just outside of Hudson, New York and is designed in service of its breathtaking surroundings. Finally we go abroad to Budapest for an International Spotlight: The Palace of Arts - MÜPA - one of Hungary’s most significant cultural and architectural developments of the last 100 years.

programme.title: Austin Flipsters
programme.desc: Join Lauren and Lincoln, the Austin Flipsters, as they take on the grossest house on the block—a moldy, overgrown disaster with structural issues and termite damage. Watch as they completely transform this eyesore into a stunning home, breathing new life into the neighborhood and creating a space future generations will cherish

programme.title: Hotels ByDesign
programme.desc: Hotels ByDesign Episode 3 opens with Cameron House on Loch Lomond, a 17th-century Baronial mansion, deeply rooted in the Scottish landscape and boasting exceptional elegance and breathtaking views. Then Brian Brown presents a story on Alila Napa Valley; a serene retreat designed to engage the senses and immerse guests in the California landscape. Mike Chapman takes us to Boutique Hotel Alhambra & The Historic Villas, located on the enchanting island of Lošinj, Croatia. This story explores how distinctive architectural flair and commitment to preserving cultural heritage makes this such a revitalizing destination. We showcase the award-winning French Quarter Inn in Charleston and keep the southern charm rolling with Grand Hotel - “America’s Summer Place” since 1887 - in Mackinac Island, Michigan. Grand Hotel beckons guests to a bygone era of old-world hospitality and charm.

programme.title: Hotels ByDesign
programme.desc: Episode 4 opens with Hotel 11 in Calgary - the first MOD Collection by Sonesta hotel overlooking The Rocky Mountains. Then, the award-winning Spectator Hotel in Charleston; a high-design, distinctive boutique hotel for the well-heeled traveler. Next, a revamped modernist style hotel built in the 1950s, weaving along the coast of the French Riviera - Les Roches Rouges. Hotel Zachary is located in the heart of Chicago’s Lakeview neighborhood - inspired by designs of world-renowned Wrigley Field architect Zachary Taylor Davis. Finally, discover a jewel on the bank of the majestic lake Pichola in Udaipur, India. The Leela Palace Udaipur is spectacular in its architecture and boasts a veritable gallery of traditional artwork in its interior.

programme.title: Modern Builds
programme.desc: Can you believe this is made of only plywood from the outside!?!?! This was a fun one! When I went to the Depot to price out this project over the thanksgiving holiday I got HUGE sticker shock. Instead of waiting a few days for the hardwood supplier in town to open back up, I decided to do a plywood experiment utilizing a surprisingly affordable 250' of edge banding I remembered seeing on amazon.

programme.title: Modern Builds
programme.desc: When I was reached out to by Smartwings I was shocked to find out that Rechargeable Smart Shades were a thing!!! This is such an awesome way to hug a luxury/hotel/airbnb vibe without installing electrical wire and hiring an electrician. Shades just need recharged a couple times a year and can be remote controlled, voice controlled, and fully automated. See the full home renovation tour coming soon!

programme.title: Bring Your Own Tools
programme.desc: This DIY mobile garage storage tutorial is all about how to build a mobile storage work table from start to finish. This DIY 12 tote storage solution will free up garage space fast and has a clam shell design.

programme.title: Simple Dwelling
programme.desc: Set within a vibrant streetscape opposite a park, this Yarraville home reimagines living with a seamless blend of privacy and connection, while bringing focus to the important moments in life. Through a considered design by Weaver+Co Architects, the original weatherboard bungalow—beyond repair—was replaced with a modern light-filled and minimalist four-bedroom home for a family of five.

programme.title: America ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Episode 6 opens with Sutton Tower. Quintessentially New York, this residential high-rise offers never before experienced vistas spanning from the East River to the Atlantic Ocean, the New York City skyline and beyond. Then, Thomas Wong leads a story about an iconic civic space that tells the story of veterans from Ohio and across the nation - the National Veterans Memorial & Museum. Next the show takes us to Washington DC and The Duke Ellington School of Arts - designed and developed to “house the creative soul of the District”. We end this episode with architecture focused on drawing people together and providing transcendent group experiences - the TQL Stadium in Cincinnati, Ohio.

programme.title: America ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc:
The season finale of America ByDesign: Architecture opens in Washington DC, with Benjamin Banneker Academic High School - exploring how the design has enhanced student wellbeing and learning. Then, the Stanley Center for Peace and Security on the banks of the Mississippi River, dedicated to making a positive impact for peace on a local and global scale. Next, an international spotlight on Paris designer, Sophie Mallebranche - creating unique, luxury woven metal materials for high-end interior architecture and design. Finally, a teaser for an upcoming architecture story - One High Line Residences - bordering the famous High Line in New York City.
Now that the season is complete, revisit your favorite stories and cast your vote in the Ferguson People’s Choice Award! Head to bydesign.global to tell us in 15 words or less which project you like best and why. You and a friend could win flights to New York, staying 2 nights at one of Sonesta’s 4 New York properties, enjoy an exclusive VIP guest tour of the Ferguson New York City showroom and select a range of lighting and fans for your project, courtesy of Minka Group. Most creative answer wins.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Uncovering the stories behind some of Australia ’s finest architectural design s, we visit Bruny Island’s house at the end of the world, shine a spotlight on renowned Victorian Government Architect, Jill Garner, and discover Lisa McGuigan’s bold cellar door vision in Vamp.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Uncovering the stories behind some of Australia ’s finest architectural designs, we explore an unlikely theatre in Sydney’s West, how Brisbane’s overlay preservation gave two owner-engineers an idea, and how two young architects returned to simple, sustainable design principles on the Mornington Peninsula.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Uncovering the stories behind some of Australia ’s finest architectural designs, we learn how the InterContinental has embraced its heritage in Sydney, how a Perth architect decided he had to build a demo house to prove medium density is the future, and we visit a house built in the clouds above the Great Ocean Road.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Uncovering the stories behind some of Australia ’s finest architectural design s, we discover a boldly designed party house in Brisbane’s hottest suburb of Hamilton, how the design of Fremantle’s new civic centre promotes democratic transparency, and we shine the spotlight on internationally acclaimed Danish architect, Bjarke Ingles

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Uncovering the stories behind some of Australia’s finest architectural designs, we learn how a holiday ho use was built on Stradbroke Island to retain the connection to nature that camping brings, and we go bush in southern Tasmania to see how a rich heritage of architecturally designed , eco-tourism walker accommodation has been built on .

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Uncovering the stories behind some of Australia’s finest architectural designs, we learn how Australian design has infused the headquarters of the American Australian Association in New York, how an innovative use of material and organic forms is luring people back in to the workplace, and we reveal our Commentator’s Choice of the series.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: In this episode, we finally count down the best of the best in Australian architecture. Our judges and experts have come together to share with you the top 10 architectural feats of Series 1. Make sure you stick around to find out who the winner is!

programme.title: Hotels ByDesign
programme.desc: In this series, our ByDesign team discover some of the most impressive designed hotels in America and beyond. This episode we explore the Hard Rock Hotel in New York with the designer Jeffrey Beers, Mike travels to Mexico to the remarkable Las Ventanas Al Paraíso, two hotel offerings in one in Austin Texas with the Tommy and the Thompson, the Shinola Hotel in Detroit and The Redline Inn in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, where they celebrate Norman Rockwell’s famous painting every Christmas.

programme.title: Hotels ByDesign
programme.desc: In this episode, the Edgewood Tahoe Resort on the shores of Lake Tahoe in Nevada, we travel to Orlando to experience two hotels – the Lake Nona Wave & Four Seasons Orlando. Renowned French lighting designer Herve Descottes visits Saint Kate - The Arts Hotel in Milwaukee, Mike travels to Dubai to the Mandarin Oriental Jumeira, and we deep dive on the design intent of the Omni Boston Hotel at the Seaport.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: With space at a premium in the most populated area of Australia, designers and architects have had to be creative in their use of space to maximise a buildings potential, whether it’s a holiday home, childcare facility or downtown restaurant. Watch as we count down the best buildings in New South Wales and the Australian Capital territory.

programme.title: Australia ByDesign: Architecture
programme.desc: Queensland, Australia is known as the tropical region of the country, which brings its challenges when it comes to designing a home. Watch us countdown ten of the best ways architects have worked around these limitations to create something fresh and new to this difficult environment.

programme.title: The Travelling Chef
programme.desc: Brett is invited to the beautiful Malaysian island of Langkawi by a local chef who is looking for some new recipes for his seafood restaurant.
